curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a clever newborn boy uncover a way to outwit a formidable sorceress and rescue his endangered village?
curatedMovie.description: Drawing from West African folk tales, this animated adventure follows Kirikou, a precocious newborn boy who immediately sets out to protect his imperiled village from the powerful sorceress Karaba.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Vibrant, brisk, and family-friendly, balancing exciting folk-tale stakes with an accessible 71-minute pace.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Michel Ocelot crafts a vibrant, concise fantasy adventure that reimagines traditional folklore into a spirited and visually distinctive animated journey.
